name: camera-free
description: Create Free Camera and Set Camera To Current View of a free camera (branch feat/free-camera, 2026-11-26, SD; camera-farz.w3m: eight cameras at 0, 0 from 500 to 5000). Three cameras (500, 2000 and 3000 away) are viewed and a free camera made from each view; then the second camera is viewed and the first free camera set to that view: it stays a free camera. Studio: Cameras tab, View, Create free camera, Set from view. Expected MATCH. Allowed: 0.1 in the places (the editor's own are 0.07 off the geometry), and Roll, which it writes as 360 for some of these cameras where Studio writes 0 (the same angle)

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const jump = document.querySelector('select[title="Go to a camera"]'); if (!jump) throw new Error('no Cameras tab'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && jump.options.length < 9; i++) await wait(250); const btn = (sel, t) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].find((b) => b.textContent === t); if (!b) throw new Error('no ' + t + ' button'); return b; }; const pick = async (n) => { const o = [...jump.options].find((o) => o.textContent === '00 we-drive look 0' + n); if (!o) throw new Error('no camera ' + n); jump.value = o.value; jump.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await wait(300); }; const look = async (n) => { await pick(n); btn('.terrain-region-panel button', 'View').click(); await wait(500); }; for (const n of [1, 4, 6]) { await look(n); btn('.terrain-group-tools button', 'Create free camera').click(); await wait(800); } await look(2); const ed = window.__driveEd; const view = ed.view(); const last = [...jump.options].find((o) => o.textContent === 'Camera 009'); jump.value = last.value; jump.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await wait(400); ed.setView(view); await wait(300); btn('.terrain-region-panel button', 'Set from view').click(); await wait(800); await w3.editors.saveAll();
